note: Tiny labelled premise corpus for F1 trainable retrieval. Not Mathlib. Not production. Never cite as evidence about mathematics.

premises.add_comm: addition is commutative: a + b equals b + a on naturals
premises.add_assoc: addition is associative: (a + b) + c equals a + (b + c)
premises.mul_comm: multiplication is commutative: a * b equals b * a
premises.mul_assoc: multiplication is associative: (a * b) * c equals a * (b * c)
premises.nat_zero: zero is the additive identity on natural numbers: a + 0 equals a
premises.nat_one: one is the multiplicative identity on natural numbers: a * 1 equals a
premises.nat_lt_succ: every natural is less than its successor
premises.list_append_nil: appending nil on the right leaves a list unchanged
premises.list_length_append: length of append is sum of lengths
premises.eq_refl: equality is reflexive: every term equals itself

queries.goal: prove a + b = b + a on naturals
